newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen up on Wall Street, rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen up on Wall Street, rupiah.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen staging a rebound on Wednesday after the strong overnight rise on Wall Street and the strengthening in the rupiah, brokers said.
"We expect a slight rebound in the index today as sentiment is likely to improve after a jump on Wall Street overnight and a rebound in the rupiah," one broker said.
The Dow index jumped 154.93 points to 8,061.65 overnight after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks assured Wall Street that interest rates will remain steady for some time.
The rupiah rose to 2,530/40 against the dollar at 0145 GMT on Wednesday from an opening of 2,570/80, dealers said.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 0.96 points lower at 711.44 points, with newly-listed counters staging modest debuts despite cautious sentiment because of the weak rupiah, brokers said.
Stocks to watch included textile firm Panasia Filament and Lippo General Insurance after modest debuts on Tuesday, brokers said.
Tin miner Tambang Timah rose 25 rupiah to 3,200 rupiah despite a sharp fall in tin prices.

Tin prices fell to a fresh two-and-half year low overnight on the London Metal Exchange as Southeast Asian tin producers boosted their sales to take advantage of their currencies' recent falls against the dollar.
